scope: Reactive Meets AI; Base Sepolia origin and destination, Lasna coordinator.

checks.action: Fund the scoped Base Sepolia and Lasna wallet, then complete scripts/deploy-testnet.mjs.
Run scripts/live-agent.mjs --prepare, review its digest, then complete the approved public loop and preserve all six receipts.
Publish the current original source in a public GitHub repository. Record its immutable commit in evidence/submission-input.json, then rerun with --online.
Record the completed public loop in a final video under 180 seconds. Set video.scope to submission, provide its local path and a direct public HTTPS file URL, then rerun with --online.
Complete the model-linked public loop and rerun with --online. Local demos, preflights, historical flags, and deployment-only evidence cannot satisfy this gate.

limits: Ready means the recorded materials passed these checks, not that a DoraHacks entry was submitted.
RPC-reported canonical receipts are trusted observations, not cryptographic finality proofs.
Model metadata and approval digests establish recorded source and operation binding, not cryptographic proof of inference or a human signature.
